verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a framework for building realtime voice and video agents, with LLM tool use, RAG lookups and MCP integration. These are developer building blocks for constructing such a feature, not a product feature that surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's own data. No evidence shows an in-product insights capability, for example AI analysis of session or call data in LiveKit Cloud.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
